title_ru: JANUS JSON: прямой проход → зеркальный обратный проход → сначала показать то, что было пропущено
core_rule: EVERY_RESEARCH_JSON_MUST_RUN_FORWARD_AND_REVERSE; THE DOCUMENT SHOULD SURFACE REVERSE-ONLY FINDINGS BEFORE THE ORIGINAL FORWARD STORY.

forward_pass.purpose: Show how the first interpretation was constructed from the available starting evidence.
forward_pass.rule: Do not rewrite the forward pass after seeing the reverse result; preserve it so the delta remains auditable.

reverse_pass.purpose: Ask what must be true for the terminal state to exist, then trace those necessities backward until reaching evidence-bearing source nodes.
questions: What is logically required immediately before the terminal state?
Which node in the forward chain was assumed rather than demonstrated?
Did the forward pass confuse role, identity, custody, location, chronology or symbolic similarity?
Does reversing the chain expose a missing bridge or a stronger alternative route?
Which claim becomes weaker, stronger or differently classified after reversal?

missed_on_forward_pass.rule: List only insights that became visible because the chain was traversed from end to beginning.

mirror_delta.principle: The value of the reverse pass is the difference between the two traversals, not merely repeating the same chain backward.

canonical_compact_formula: FORWARD -> TERMINAL -> REVERSE -> MISSED_NODE -> MIRROR_DELTA -> TEST
canonical_seal: JANUS HAS TWO FACES: ONE SEES HOW WE ARRIVED; THE OTHER SEES WHAT HAD TO BE THERE ALL ALONG. WRITE THE SECOND DISCOVERY FIRST.
